passage.title: The Secret Seed
paras: Amna found a seed in her coat pocket. It was small and brown, like a tiny button.
'What will you grow into?' she whispered. She did not know.
Amna filled a pot with soil. She pushed the seed in with her finger and gave it a drink of water. She put the pot on the windowsill, where the sun could reach it.
Every morning, Amna checked the pot. Nothing happened. On the fifth day, she nearly gave up.
Then, on the sixth day, she saw a tiny green shoot poking out of the soil. Amna smiled. 'Alhamdulillah,' she said. 'You were just waiting.'
